channel.title: Triangulated News
channel.description: Daily news digest — only stories confirmed by multiple independent outlets. Wire reprints count as one. BBC and CNN excluded.

item.title: Parti Québécois wins minority government — first return since 2014
item.description: The Parti Québécois won a minority government overnight, taking 59 of 127 seats — its first return to power since 2014, but short of a majority. The CAQ was shut out. A sovereignty referendum would come only after 2029. Prime Minister Mark Carney congratulated the winner.

item.title: Smith says she has no knowledge of reported separatist–U.S. strategist meetings
item.description: Premier Danielle Smith’s office said Monday she has no knowledge of reported meetings between Alberta separatists and U.S. strategists, and that she opposes separation or Alberta becoming a U.S. state. Sylvestre and Rath denied offering oil, water, or royalties.

item.title: Oct. 19 Alberta referendum: special ballots, advance voting, and safeguards
item.description: Albertans vote Oct. 19 on 10 referendum questions, including separation process. Elections Alberta: 652,000+ special ballots approved; packages due by 5 p.m. Oct. 16; advance voting Oct. 13–17.

item.title: Hundreds rally at Churchill Square over Edmonton infill
item.description: Hundreds gathered Sunday at Churchill Square in Edmonton over residential infill. Public hearings are scheduled for Oct. 13.

item.title: Six Nations Haldimand Tract trial opens in Toronto
item.description: A civil trial over the Six Nations’ Haldimand Tract land claim opened Monday in Toronto.

item.title: Ukrainian drone attack on Moscow region kills two; nearly 900 drones claimed intercepted
item.description: A Ukrainian drone attack on Russia’s Moscow region killed two people. Russian authorities claimed nearly 900 drones were intercepted.

item.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces push toward Bab el-Mandeb; Houthi denial; unverified by AP/Reuters
item.description: Yemeni government and Saudi-backed forces said they drove Houthis from areas around Bab el-Mandeb. Houthis denied the claims. AP and Reuters could not independently verify.

item.title: Kenya records first Ebola death — imported case from DRC
item.description: Kenya reported its first Ebola-related death after an imported case from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Contact tracing is under way.

item.title: Emera and Canadian Utilities announce $72-billion combination
item.description: Emera, Canadian Utilities, and ATCO announced an agreement to combine into a Canadian utility and energy infrastructure company valued at about $72 billion.

item.title: Canada’s trade surplus widens to $4.2 billion in August
item.description: Statistics Canada reported that Canada’s merchandise trade surplus widened to $4.2 billion in August 2026.

item.title: [Unconfirmed] Reports of Moscow-region fuel depot fire
item.description: Some reports described a fuel depot fire in the Moscow region. This has not been officially confirmed by independent reporting meeting the digest’s triangulation standard.
